records.speaker: Port Worker
records.context: Departure check after a low-supplies report.
records.source_meaning: The port worker offers to resupply the fleet for the substituted number of gold coins.
records.localization_note: The direct price question follows the crew’s warning and uses gold naturally for any amount.
records.Japanese:
金貨%s枚で
補給するかい？

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.context: Refilling water would leave too much food for the new mix. The worker asks before discarding it.
records.source_meaning: The surplus food would be discarded, so the worker asks if that is all right.
records.localization_note: Use the worker’s conversational voice and give the complete consequence before the yes/no question.
records.english: We'll throw out any extra food. Is that okay?
records.Japanese:
余った食料は捨てることになるぜ
いいかい？
records.previous_English:
Any excess food will be thrown
  away. Is that okay?
before_lines: Any excess food will be thrown
visible_lines: We'll throw out any extra food.

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.context: Refilling food would leave too much water for the new mix.
records.source_meaning: The surplus water would be disposed of. The worker asks permission to proceed.
records.localization_note: Dumped suits the concrete action. Both the warning and the short confirmation already read in full.
records.english: Any excess water will be dumped. Is that okay?
records.Japanese:
余った水は捨てることになるが
いいかい？
records.previous_English:
Any excess water will be dumped.

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.context: The worker notices a shortage before the player sees the disposal prompt or the bill.
records.source_meaning: Water looks low. The worker offers to replenish it.
records.localization_note: Keep the worker’s brisk question and place it together on the next line.
records.english: You're running low on water. Need to stock up?
records.Japanese: 水が少ないようだな。補給するかい？

You're running low on water. Need

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.context: The port worker sees fatigue while the player is preparing to depart.
records.source_meaning: The sailors look tired. The worker recommends resting at the inn.
records.localization_note: The soft suggestion respects the player’s choice. Keep “Why not” with the rest of the question.
records.english: Your sailors look tired. Why not let them rest at the inn?
records.Japanese:
水夫たちが疲れてるようだぜ
宿屋で休んだほうが
いいんじゃないか？
records.previous_English:
Your sailors look tired. Why not
  let them rest at the inn?

let them rest at the inn?
visible_lines: Why not let them rest at the inn?

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.context: The player chooses a cargo action with no cargo aboard.
records.source_meaning: The port worker points out that the player has no cargo.
records.localization_note: The matter-of-fact reply fits the immediate refusal. No extra greeting is needed.
records.Japanese: あんた、積み荷は何もないだろ

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.context: The wallet cannot cover the full refill, but the worker offers a smaller purchase.
records.source_meaning: The player lacks funds for a full resupply. The worker asks if they want only what they can afford.
records.localization_note: Keep both the limit and the choice in the worker’s voice. Each lands as a complete sentence.
records.english: You can't afford a full resupply. Want to buy what you can?
records.Japanese:
十分に補給するには金が足りねえな
足りる分だけ補給するかい？
